name: Clover Voice
description: Your bots' voices: it speaks their replies and hears what you say with push-to-talk, one sound at a time, through the voice provider each bot uses (Fish Audio, or another you add). Turned off, bots are text-only.

active.title: Active voice
active.description: The voice that speaks for your bots and hears you on this computer: Clover Voice, or another voice plugin you installed. Empty is Clover Voice.
